name: Music
summary: Connect your Epidemic Sound subscription, find music, preview tracks and add them to your Draft.

compatibility.selects: Requires music.epidemic.mcp-key.v1 and the user's own Epidemic MCP API key. Download permissions depend on the user's Epidemic account. Creator MP3 download, editable Audio, reload and WAV export verified. Video is optional. Experimental; MP4 export failed with local FFmpeg 9, and Windows remains unverified. Export usage reporting and safelisting are not integrated.
